verdict.rationale: Kick documents an access-gated Platform API with per-operation OpenAPI 3.0.2 fragments, but nothing in the evidence shows API versioning (for example versioned paths or headers) or a documented deprecation or sunset policy. The OpenAPI spec version describes the document format, not an API versioning scheme. The axis applies to a SaaS product with a public API, so absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
